name: wrapfit-monorepo
description: WrapFit Monorepo — Packaging Personalization & Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:setup && concurrently --names api,worker,fe --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:be" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:fe"
scripts.dev:setup: npm run dev:services && npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=be run db:generate && npm --workspace=be run db:deploy && npm --workspace=be run db:seed
scripts.dev:services: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis seaweedfs mailpit && docker compose run --rm -T storage-init
scripts.build:fe: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=fe run build
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=fe run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=be run build && npm --workspace=fe run build
